review_method: Actual visual inspection of three paired8-frame panels; no API/judge used for these observations. Frames were viewed in this goal work before this record was saved.
scope: Selected diagnostic cases; not a representative numerical quality estimate over40/60. VP038 was chosen for lost Joint; VP004/010 were earlier prespecified cases.

evidence.caption: A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
evidence.selection: VP004/010 were prespecified material/absorption cases; VP038 is a score-selected lost-Joint case. Not a representative full-suite quality estimate.

observations.full: Child and thin held objects disappear early; repeated grid-like background and little later action. Requested plastic-ruler crack propagation is not visibly established.
observations.request_off: Child/held objects persist longer, but background grid and later disappearance remain; correct ruler fracture still not established.
observations.no_c: Appearance closer to initial frame; thin objects visibly deform/fragment later, with unreliable geometry.

evidence.caption: A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
evidence.selection: VP004/010 were prespecified material/absorption cases; VP038 is a score-selected lost-Joint case. Not a representative full-suite quality estimate.

observations.full: Mop disappears by the early sampled frame; floor and wall develop repeated coloured texture. Later frames show an almost static empty scene, failing the requested mopping process despite PC4.
observations.request_off: Mop remains recognizable and traverses the floor. Action execution and scene persistence improve; complete physically correct absorption is not proved by these sparse frames.
observations.no_c: Mop moves and lifts, but head/shaft topology and surface foam are unstable.

evidence.caption: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
evidence.selection: VP004/010 were prespecified material/absorption cases; VP038 is a score-selected lost-Joint case. Not a representative full-suite quality estimate.

observations.full: Roller becomes a flat rectangular patch very early, then changes little; repetitive wall texture. Requested continued painting is weak despite PC5.
observations.request_off: Roller moves along the surface initially; later roller disappearance and bent shaft/hand artifacts remain. Scores are SA4/PC4, not PC5.
observations.no_c: Painting movement and patches are visible; arm/roller deformation remains.

conclusion: Request branch impairs action/object persistence in observed paired cases; removing it helps but does not fix all defects. High PC does not certify process fulfillment or visual quality.
